model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” for several language families across different models. The horizontal axis represents language family, with categories labeled “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at 5-unit intervals. The chart contains grouped bars for six different models: “mBERT-L2” (light green), “XLM-L2” (light blue), “mBERT-R2” (medium green), “XLM-R2” (medium blue), “mBERT-B2” (light red), and “XLM-B2” (light pink). Within each language family, each model is represented by a single bar, and each of these bars includes error bars extending above and below the mean. For “IE-Baltic”, the approximate values range from approximately 5 for “XLM-B2” to about 7 for “mBERT-L2”. The tallest bars in the chart, those representing “IE-Germanic”, have values approximately between 18 and 28 depending on the model, with “mBERT-L2” being the tallest at approximately 28. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
